stories.title: Canada to ban fees for moving investment accounts
stories.summary: The federal government has released draft regulations that would prohibit banks from charging fees when a client transfers an investment account to another financial institution. The ban would cover registered accounts such as RRSPs, TFSAs and RESPs, as well as non‑registered investment accounts held at Canadian banks. A regulatory impact analysis estimates the eliminated fees are typically about $150 per account.
stories.why: It lowers costs for savers, particularly lower‑income Canadians, and helps smaller institutions compete.

stories.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
stories.summary: Max Justicz, the chief technology officer and co-founder of the startup Charge Robotics, used an OpenAI model to find a severe vulnerability that — if exploited — could allow hackers to take control of servers running Ubuntu, a widely used open source Linux-based operating system. Justicz, who has a hobbyist’s interest in cybersecurity and previously found a vulnerability in the same codebase, told TechCrunch that he found this issue using GPT 5.6 Sol, released in July, through the AI maker’s Daybreak Blue, a program that gives cybersecurity defenders access to powerful frontier models.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.

stories.title: American midterm results will not have an impact on India-US interim trade deal: Sources
stories.summary: The Democrats' sweeping victory in the US midterm elections is unlikely to affect the India-US interim trade agreement, as the pact does not require formal Congressional ratification, sources said. The US midterm election results are unlikely to derail the India-US interim trade deal, but ongoing American tariff investigations remain a key hurdle to finalising the agreement.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.summary: Ajay Srivastava, Founder of the Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI) said the election results could push Trump to focus more on trade negotiations and expedite the proposed agreement with India.
